scientific_integrity: Two explicit all-pairs path certificates and three exact metric equality constructions give a self-contained proof, with a supplementary standalone rational checker. Full independent audit has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the first-power metric-valued inequality on GP(5,2) with equal unit rim conductances and a positive common spoke conductance; no p>1 assertion, general edge weighting, or complete equality-map classification. Independent bibliographic priority remains unverified.
title: A sharp three-phase nonlinear Poincaré law for spoke-weighted Petersen graphs
